_about: Held-out evaluation. Document: Lewis et al., Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks (arXiv 2005.11401v4). The document was not used during development. Questions and expected strings were written before the system processed the document, from text extracted with a different library (pypdf); the most-cited reference was counted with a separate script. Run once; results reported as measured.
